# shopify_url_redirect (Resource)

An online store URL redirect from a path to a target. **A poor fit for Terraform:** redirects are also created by the admin (for example when a handle changes) and by apps, so what Terraform manages can drift often. Path and target must be given in the canonical form Shopify stores, so nothing is rewritten after apply. A path that already has a redirect needs `adopt_existing = true`; destroy then leaves it in place. Import with the path, for example `/old-page`. A redirect holds no data that config can't restore, so there is no `allow_data_deletion`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Path and target are given as Shopify stores them: lower case, no trailing slash, special characters percent-encoded.
resource "shopify_url_redirect" "old_page" {
  path   = "/old-page"
  target = "/pages/new-page"
}

# The target may be an absolute URL.
resource "shopify_url_redirect" "campaign" {
  path   = "/summer"
  target = "https://example.com/collections/summer?ref=redirect"
}

# Takes over a redirect that already exists; destroy leaves it in place.
resource "shopify_url_redirect" "existing" {
  path           = "/legacy"
  target         = "/collections/all"
  adopt_existing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The path to redirect from, unique per shop. Changing it renames the redirect in place. Must start with `/`, be lower case, have no trailing `/` and no `#fragment`, and have whitespace, non-ASCII characters and a literal `%` percent-encoded in lower case (`%20`, `%c3%a9`, `%25`). A query string is allowed, in lower case.
- `target` (String) Where to redirect to: a path starting with `/`, or an absolute URL such as `https://example.com/x` with a lower-case scheme and host and a `/` after the host. Whitespace and non-ASCII characters must be percent-encoded. Shopify refuses a target equal to the path.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing URL redirect with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) URL redirect GID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <path>, as Shopify stores it: lower case, no trailing slash
terraform import shopify_url_redirect.old_page /old-page
```
